scope: Read-only material/semantic attribution; no production changes, no numerical or visual result fabricated.

sourceFindings.fact: csType material mapping is skin=0, teeth=1, gums=2, tongue=3, scleras=4, irises=5, pupils=6. Original GNM skin vertices receive csRegion.x=1; canonical recipes interpolate coverage only across skin endpoints.

oral_skin_ids is a separate native semantic list. H5 interpolates its binary membership via canonical.gnmRecipes into l19Oral. All derived attributes, including this flag, are midpoint-interpolated by inherited display subdivisions.

Kl clamps l19Oral into samples.inner for csType<.5; writes l19State.x; builds inside (> .25) and oralSurface (> .001 plus csType .5..3.5). The native vertex shader passes l19State and l19Detail to the fragment.
Original U5 explicitly adds lpMucosa into lpMask, its moist response, mucosal tissue tint, and outgoing-light depth attenuation.

Procedural-head geometryFor assigns every triangle with csType<.5 and csRegion.x>.5 to its new skin slot, ignoring l19Oral. With full-body active it does not apply the head y limit. Consequently any oral-skin triangle satisfying that predicate is assigned to the procedural skin. Exact live counts require runtime.

The new procedural-head material explicitly copies native vertexShader and uniforms, but discards native fragmentShader. Original mucosa color/roughness/depth behavior cannot survive on that slot merely because l19Oral remains in geometry.
R02 references vL19State.x only in its wet-reflection field while lrMask stays outer-rail/front/cover constrained. It does not restore an independent whole oral-skin material responsibility.
Non-skin dental, gums and tongue triangles fail the new-skin predicate and retain v.skin.material. Do not globally darken them while repairing lost oral-skin ownership.

materialObjects.nativeName: Not assigned by inspected native constructor; runtime must report actual name.
materialObjects.slots: Use actual material object identity; source default is [native, procedural], groups 0/1.

uniformSources.csTone/csLipColor/csLipMix: Inherited common-skin U, updated from viewer.skin.settings; actual colors are linear Three Color values
uniformSources.retention: Procedural-head copies the actual native uniform objects from vertexContract, so existing updateLips updates them. Declare any reused native uniforms only once in the new fragment.

attributeSources.l19Oral: Fixed native oral_skin_ids semantic membership through canonical recipes; interpolated during display subdivision.
attributeSources.vL19State.x: clamped l19Oral on csType<.5, independent of current lighting/camera.
attributeSources.vL19State.y: Across-furrow tangent stretch; not a mucosa identifier.
attributeSources.vL19State.z: Native red/vermilion geometric field; not all oral skin.
attributeSources.vL19State.w: Contact/pressure authoring proxy from Ql, not measured perfusion.
attributeSources.vL19Detail.y: Native geometric furrow amplitude in mm.
attributeSources.vL19Detail.z: Native upper/lower flag written only for topology.active (1 upper, 0 lower). Deep oralSkin can be outside active and retain its initial 0. Do not use this as a complete mucosal upper/lower map; the original F5 computes lpUpper from inner rest rails and vFRest.y.
attributeSources.vL19Detail.w: On oralSurface: max(0, dot(mouthCenter-currentVertex, currentMouthFront))/max(.35, clamp(currentMouthWidth/restMouthWidth,.35,2.2)). On other active skin this component may be the prior Boolean skin flag! Strict semantic gating is mandatory.

opticalApproximations: lpColor blood/melanin exponents and mucosa RGB multiplier (.83,.67,.68)*.72 are native artistic appearance controls, not measured optical coefficients or concentration.

Native l19Visibility=.12+.88*exp(-max(0,vL19Detail.w)*120) is an authored mouth-depth visibility approximation. The depth is frontal depth normalized by mouth scale, not measured photon path or volume SSS.
Native wetGain clamps uLWet/.35 times per-lip wetness. It is a rendering gain, not calibrated physiological hydration.
Native source itself reports measuredOptics:false, no measured volumetric scattering, no saliva simulation.

recommendedAttributionExperiment.purpose: Verify whether semantic native oral-skin shading changes the pale inner surface at matched geometry/pose/light.
recommendedAttributionExperiment.mutation: Only in a disposable QA page, move procedural-slot triangles whose 3 vertices are skin and l19State.x>=.999 into the existing native slot. Keep mixed triangles unchanged for this narrow attribution.
recommendedAttributionExperiment.restore: Save original index BufferAttribute and deep copied groups; finally restore exact objects/groups, redraw and compare position/normal data and restored pixels.
recommendedAttributionExperiment.cacheContract: geometryFor returns cached drawGeometry immediately without mutating its index/groups. Per-frame renderer sets mesh.geometry to that cached object. Assert identity before each diagnostic draw.
recommendedAttributionExperiment.notFinalDesign: Whole-triangle reassignment hardens a continuous semantic boundary and also restores several older artistic components. It is evidence of material responsibility, not a final quality solution.

finalImplementationBoundary: If real mixed/visible statistics support it, restore a continuous semantic-gated mucosa branch into the shared procedural shader. Do not make another overlapping mesh.
Do not multiply mucosa inclusion by external lrMask/front/rail silhouette: this is precisely the deeper-surface omission being audited.
Do not apply depth attenuation outside mucosa; vL19Detail.w is overloaded on non-oral skin.
Choose upper/lower oral DNA using original F5 rest rails, not vL19Detail.z whose updates cover only topology.active.
Keep teeth/gums/tongue and external vermilion changes separated in verification; their old native behavior was not removed by the new-skin slot.
Diagnose frame identity and color/depth contributions independently; a pale frame alone never proves a geometry defect.
